name: Auto-Assign on Create
description: Automatically assigns issues to a user based on issue type

name: Enforce Subtask Resolution
description: Blocks transition if any subtask is not resolved (use as condition)

name: Required Comment Validator
description: Requires a comment on transition (use as validator)

name: Cascade Field Updates
description: When parent issue changes priority, update all subtask priorities (post-function)

name: SLA Tracker
description: Calculates time elapsed since issue creation and warns if SLA breached (calculated field)

name: Email Notification on Transition
description: Sends a custom email when issue transitions to a specific status (post-function)

name: Bulk Transition by JQL
description: Searches for issues matching JQL and transitions them (scheduled script)

name: HTTP Webhook Integration
description: Calls an external REST API when an issue is updated (listener)

name: Field Behavior — Hide Environment for Epics
description: Hides the Environment field when issue type is Epic (field behavior)

name: Reusable Utilities Library
description: Common helper functions for other scripts to include (library)
